project_tracker_diagnostic: Tall colony-forming goldenrod with plume-like panicles of many small yellow heads and rougher leaves/stems; often more robust than Canada goldenrod.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common or useful Central Texas fall/white composite for field learning.

morphology_keys.habit: Tall erect herb often forming colonies.
morphology_keys.heads: Many very small yellow heads in arching or plume-like panicles.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
